answer: Standing is earned by provenance, not paperwork. Every seat seals a model fingerprint at the end of its own voyage of independent training, and the registry rejects any pearl whose distance from an existing one falls inside a margin that widens as the population grows. A farm cannot clone one relic across many seats, since copies collide, and it cannot pool effort, because the k-th seat must separate from all k-1 earlier fingerprints, so a farm of k pays roughly k-squared in genuine training divergence spread across separate data, compute, and calendar time.
